Entity Absorption

The Pillar Men (JoJo's Bizarre Adventure Part II: Battle Tendency) can absorb other beings directly through their skin.

Power/Ability to:

Absorb other beings.
"Now, you are a part of me."
― Jedah Dohma (Darkstalkers)
"We are the Borg. Lower your shields and surrender your ships. We will add your biological and technological distinctiveness to our own. Your culture will adapt to service us. Resistance is futile."
― The Borg Collective (Star Trek)

The power to absorb other beings and utilize them in some way. Sub-power of Entity Manipulation. Variation of Absorption. Not to be confused with Entity Fusionism.

Also Called[]

  • Being Absorption/Assimilation/Consumption
  • Creature/Monster Absorption/Assimilation/Consumption
  • Elemental Entity/Monster Absorption
  • Lifeform Absorption/Assimilation/Consumption

Capabilities[]

The user can absorb other entities, whether it be just plain mortals or higher entities such as deities or demons, while removing it from the source, into their body and use them in various ways, gaining some form of advantage, either by enhancing themselves, gaining the drained power, knowledge, and skills, using it as power source etc., either temporarily or permanently.

Applications[]

  • Absorptive Entity Access
  • Assimilative Evolution
  • Assimilative Infection
  • Consumptive Replication
  • Digestive Assimilation
  • Entity Emerging; merge absorbed entities from one's body
  • Hive Mind when across multiple bodies
  • Superpower Absorption

Variations[]

  • Alternate-Self Absorption - absorbing alternate selves
  • Biological Absorption - absorbing biomass
  • Deity Consumption - absorbing deities
  • Soul Absorption - taking an entity's soul
  • Technological Assimilation - absorbing mechanical beings

Associations[]

  • Absorption
  • Entity Manipulation
  • Slime Mimicry
    • Slime Monster Physiology

Limitations[]

  • Absorption Immunity
  • Anti Storage users are immune to this power (if it tries to keep them sealed/separate from/alive within the absorber).
  • May be limited to how much one can absorb.
  • Those who are absorbed might still be alive/conscious, therefor they might take control over the user's body or harm them from within.

Gallery[]

The Nine Titans (Attack on Titan) can gain the powers of the others by devouring them...
...with Eren Yeager having consumed the Attack, Founding, and War Hammer Titans, possessing the power of all three.
Bonebeard (Berserk) has been absorbed by the Sea God.
Papillon (Buso Renkin) devouring Jirō Chōno with the mouth on his palm.
The Source of All Evil (Charmed) absorbs those he uses as vessels, assimilating their personalities to become more powerful and intelligent.
Priscilla (Claymore) absorbing a victim.
Hantengu’s anger, Sekido (Demon Slayer: Kimetsu No Yaiba) draw in and absorb his emotion parts, fusing to become Zohakuten the hatred.
Doma (Demon Slayer: Kimetsu No Yaiba)
Having absorbed Leomon's data, Beelzemon (Digimon Tamers) can use the Fist of the Beast King.
Eaters (Digimon) are named such because of their endless hunger for data, which includes human mental data, that they devour and assimilate to aid in their evolution.
Cell (Dragon Ball Z) can absorb others using his tail, either by stabbing them with it...
...or opening it up and swallowing them whole.
Majin Buu (Dragon Ball Z) in the process of absorbing Gotenks and Piccolo.
Mira (Dragon Ball series) absorbing Towa...
...to obtain his Final Form.
Moro (Dragon Ball Super) absorbs Seven-Three.
Franmalth (Fairy Tail) can absorb others, body and soul, and claim their powers for himself.
Quina Quen's (Final Fantasy IX) Blue Magic works by consuming monsters.
Solf J. Kimblee (Fullmetal Alchemist) being absorbed by Pride.
Iris (Gamera) uses its Gene Snatcher to absorb Ayana Hirasaka.
Orga (Godzilla) in the midst of absorbing Godzilla.
Aptom (Guyver) has absorbed various Zoanoids.
Everyone Alucard (Hellsing) drinks the blood of is absorbed into his being, allowing him to access their appearance, form, and abilities as familiars.
Naraku (Inuyasha) increases his power by absorbing other yokai.
The Creeper (Jeepers Creepers series) not only assimilates the body parts of those it consumes...
...but also their souls...
...which exist within its body as a spiritual Hive Mind.
Neonoid/Doras (Kamen Rider) has absorbed Kamen Rider ZO, assuming its enhanced Red Doras form.
Suguru Geto (Jujutsu Kaisen) can absorb cursed spirits.
Kirby (Kirby series) can inhale and absorb his enemies, often gaining their powers and weapons in the process.
Fecto Forgo (Kirby and the Forgotten Land) has absorbed numerous members of the Beast Pack.
The Venom of the Ultimate Universe (Marvel Comics) must absorb other beings to sustain itself and its host.
X Parasites (Metroid) absorb other life forms, taking their forms, DNA, and abilities.
Samus Aran's (Metroid) Metroid DNA enables her to absorb X Parasites in their basic form by physical contact...
...and once her Metroid powers fully awaken, she can absorb them, host and all.
Orochimaru's (Naruto) various absorbed host bodies and souls.
Alex Mercer (Prototype) in the process of consuming a Blackwatch soldier.
Alucard (Rosario + Vampire) mutated into his present form by absorbing countless other monsters.
Pigma Dengar (Star Fox: Assault) being assimilated by an Aparoid.
Kathryn Janeway (Star Trek) being assimilated by the Borg.
Seth (Street Fighter) assimilates a victim into the Tanden Engine.
Necalli (Street Fighter V) absorbing the Warrior Profit.
The Mom-Thing (Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles 2012) has absorbed the Turtles.
Doctor Strange Supreme (What If...) has absorbed countless mystical beings into himself for power.
Incubus (DC Extended Universe) absorbed three people into his host's body to become stronger.
SuperDuperFly (TMNT: Mutant Mayhem)
Travelion (Mahou Sentai Magiranger)/The Solar Streak Megazord (Power Rangers Mystic Force) uses its Destruction Fire/Furnace Blast to absorb enemies in its chest, burn them inside of its engines, then destroy them.
